claims.statement: Introduces deterministic Sinkhorn learning layers and stochastic Gumbel-Sinkhorn implicit relaxations.
Exact entropic normalization converges to a unique permutation almost surely under independent absolutely continuous entries; finite iterations are approximate.

evidence.locator: Theorem 1; Appendix A Lemmas 1-3 and full proof

claims.statement: Densities of implicit permutation distributions are intractable; an auxiliary affine-Gumbel-space KL can yield a looser bound.
Separately specified networks study sorting, puzzles, arbitrary supervised assembly and worm identity inference; success varies by task/condition.
A reusable differentiable permutation modeling/inference layer, with distinct task networks, is not one jointly trained generalist solver.

evidence.locator: Network construction; four task definitions; discussion

claims.statement: Variable image structure, temperature/truncation and surrogate variational bounds limit practical conclusions.
